entries.title: Find mønstret
entries.description: Kamæleonen grupperer eksempler og prøver derefter et nyt blad. Modellen skal kunne bruge et mønster på nye data.
entries.alt: Kamæleonen sorterer bladkort efter form og undersøger et nyt eksempel.
entries.action: Action: the chameleon teaches classification by SHAPE, not color. A small right-hand tabletop has two shallow trays: one with round leaf silhouettes and one with narrow pointed leaves, all green. Frame1: he looks at two mixed green leaf samplecards in hand. Frame2: he places a roundleaf card into the roundleaf tray. Frame3: he places a pointedleaf card into the pointedleaf tray. Frame4: he picks up a NEW roundleaf card and studies it. Frame5: he places the new roundleaf card into the roundleaf tray. Frame6: he gently smiles and gestures to the two orderly trays; clear calm resting pose. All cards/leaves remain coherent with simple clean shapes.
entries.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / animation source. Create ONE storyboard sprite sheet, exactly 1536x1024 pixels, a clean 3-column x 2-row grid of SIX square 512x512 animation frames. No gutters or gridlines. Each frame has identical flat pale cream opaque background. The attached image is the CANONICAL CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE reference. Use the exact same friendly green chameleon with orange-edged crest, warm brown turret eyes, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, brown leather craftsman's apron, brown trousers and ONE curled tail. Same head/body proportions and warm softly painted storybook finish. He is the future ML teacher, an Italian-trained violin maker who plays banjo, but no musical instrument in these educational animations.

Critical animation constraints: SIX individual frames, read left to right top row then bottom row. Same fixed camera, same subject size and consistent positions of stationary objects in EVERY cell. Each square independently contains the WHOLE chameleon, crest, feet, tail and props, with generous clear margins. Never let art cross a cell boundary. Character is about 65% cell height at left half, teaching visual occupies right half. Subtle coherent gestures across frames, no extra limbs or tails. No text, lettering, digits, frame numbers, speech bubbles, labels, logos, watermarks or decorative borders. This is a real sequential illustrated action to crop into a GIF, not a collage of random poses. Keep color and lighting consistent.

Action: the chameleon teaches classification by SHAPE, not color. A small right-hand tabletop has two shallow trays: one with round leaf silhouettes and one with narrow pointed leaves, all green. Frame1: he looks at two mixed green leaf samplecards in hand. Frame2: he places a roundleaf card into the roundleaf tray. Frame3: he places a pointedleaf card into the pointedleaf tray. Frame4: he picks up a NEW roundleaf card and studies it. Frame5: he places the new roundleaf card into the roundleaf tray. Frame6: he gently smiles and gestures to the two orderly trays; clear calm resting pose. All cards/leaves remain coherent with simple clean shapes.

entries.title: Små skridt mod en bedre model
entries.description: Kamæleonen justerer en model og sammenligner dens forudsigelser med eksemplerne. Træning bruger en valgt tabsfunktion; en pæn kurve alene viser ikke, om modellen virker på nye data.
entries.alt: Kamæleonen peger på en enkel linje, som justeres tættere på fire datapunkter.
entries.action: Action: at right is a fixed small cream drawingboard on a wood easel, showing four teal data points diagonally rising from lowerleft to upperright. A simple darkblue straight prediction line starts too low and gradually aligns near these trainingpoints. No axes numbers/text. Frame1: teacher holds a short wooden pointer, calmly observing poorly placed low line. Frame2: he points at the gap between line and a point. Frame3: line shifts a little upward while he gestures a small careful adjustment. Frame4: line shifts toward the points' trend. Frame5: line lies approximately along their trend, he checks with a modest thoughtful smile. Frame6: he lowers pointer and gives a small satisfied nod, no overexcited guaranteed-success imagery. The board and four trainingpoint positions NEVER move; only fitted line and teacher gesture change.

entries.title: Når nye data ændrer sig
entries.description: Nye data kan se anderledes ud end de data, modellen blev trænet på. Undersøg ændringen og mål kvaliteten, før du beslutter, om modellen skal trænes igen.
entries.alt: Kamæleonen opdager orange datapunkter uden for en kendt grøn gruppe og undersøger dem med en lup.
entries.action: Action: at right is a fixed small creamboard on a wood easel with a cluster of five small green data dots at leftcenter; then orange NEW data points appear toward rightside. No text/axesnumbers. Frame1: teacher watches known green cluster. Frame2: one orange dot appears at far right, teacher tilts head curiously. Frame3: a second orange dot appears nearby, teacher raises small hand to chin. Frame4: he raises a magnifying glass to examine orange dots. Frame5: he compares a little blank cream data notebook in one hand with the new orange group (no writing visible). Frame6: thoughtful resting pose pointing at new group, clearly investigation rather than automatic recoloring/retraining. Keep green dots fixed and both orange dots visible in final three frames.
